role: worker leg: one of the two further independent re-fetch spot checks required by astra-life02-l1-spotcheck

secondary_input.purpose: class-binding chain check (csv row -> used_by_theorems -> class_ids)

sample_rule: Every data row of ledger/citation_audit.csv whose citation_id is in SRC-041..SRC-060 (20 rows). No row in this range was sampled by L1-spotcheck-10 (flash-10, rows 1-20) or L1-spotcheck-11 (flash-11, rows 21-40). SRC-041, SRC-049 and SRC-057 were also sampled by deepseek-flash-07's spot check #3 and are retained as cross-check rows; the other 17 rows are new independent coverage.
fetch_locator_priority: 2. else doi present and not 10.48550/* -> https://api.crossref.org/works/<doi>
fallback: exact_locator, then evidence_url, then url (any not already tried)

verdict_rules.FETCH_FAILED: no locator in the fallback chain returned HTTP 200 after 2 attempts per locator
verdict_rules.FAIL: resolved but fetched title similarity < 0.90, or fetched year inconsistent (|delta| > 1 and no journal_ref support), or a quoted ledger excerpt segment (>=25 normalized chars) absent from the fetched record
verdict_rules.PARTIAL: resolved and title consistent and year consistent, but quoted excerpt only partly matched, or no abstract/record text was retrievable to check the excerpt
verdict_rules.MATCH: resolved, title consistent, year consistent, and all quoted excerpt segments matched the fetched record

class_binding_rules.hard: every class token in a linked theorem row's class_ids / informs_classes must be one of the frozen four, and every used_by_theorems id must exist in ledger/theorems.jsonl
class_binding_rules.annotation: the literal '(evidence/tag only)' in csv class_mapping is a non-class annotation; recorded separately, not counted as a class token
class_binding_rules.informational: csv class tokens not supported by any linked theorem row's class_ids/informs_classes are reported, not failed

falsifier: A later re-fetch at the same pinned csv sha256 315c19145065 yielding a different verdict for any sampled row, or any sampled row whose quoted ledger excerpt is contradicted by its primary locator, falsifies this spot check's verdict set. A csv hash change during the run invalidates the run (fail-closed).
no_completion_claim: worker artifact only; validation_status unverified; worker cannot set done/passed or a gate verdict; no physics result claimed
